build.description: Build a NativeScript app for a platform (ns build/prepare). Supports debug/release and device selection.

test.description: Run NativeScript tests on a device or emulator. Wraps vitest-ns for the Vitest pool or falls back to ns test.

run.description: Run a NativeScript app on a device or emulator (ns run).

debug.description: Debug a NativeScript app (ns debug) with configurable port.

clean.description: Remove NativeScript platform directories and build artifacts.

prepare.description: Prepare a NativeScript app without building (ns prepare).
